gaps.sentence: The storm did considerable ___ to the harbour wall.
gaps.explanation: 'Do damage' — uncountable; 'damages' means money awarded in court.

gaps.sentence: The comedian was so ___ that everyone cried with laughter.
gaps.explanation: 'Funny' is an adjective describing something that makes you laugh; 'fun' describes enjoyable experiences.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: He gave a ___ summary of the 40-page report.
gaps.explanation: 'A brief summary' — adjective; 'briefly' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: Look at that bird up ___ in the tree.
gaps.explanation: 'There' refers to a place; 'their' shows possession; 'they're' means 'they are'.

gaps.sentence: Be careful not to ___ your passport at the check-in desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Lose' is the verb; 'loose' means not tight.
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.

gaps.sentence: The new tax law will ___ every small business in the region.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb (to influence); 'effect' is normally the noun.
